title: Debug: The Dead Branch
prompt:
This classifier has a bug: the second branch can never run. Reorder or fix the conditions so each score range reports correctly — under 60 `"cold"`, 60–79 `"warm"`, 80+ `"hot"` for `function temp(score)`.

Rules:
- All three results reachable.
- Keep it as chained if / else if / else.

tests.name: all three ranges reachable
tests.hint: Check the highest threshold FIRST: 80+ hot, then 60+ warm, else cold.

tests.name: still chained conditionals
tests.hint: Fix the order of the conditions; the structure stays a chain.
